title: The Banquet
text: A long table laid for exactly as many as you are, down to the last cup. The candles are still warm and the wine is still breathing. Nobody has touched the food, and every chair has been pulled out a little, as if the guests only just stood up to greet you.

options.label: Sit down and eat what was laid for you. It would be rude to refuse such hospitality.

outcomes.text: It is the best meal any of you have had since the rift opened. You sleep well after, and do not wonder who cooked it.
The meat moves on the plate. The hosts arrive late, and they are hungry too.
Under one plate lies a ring that fits no finger twice. It is warm, and it is yours now.

options.label: The most seasoned of you tastes it first, while the rest watch their face.

outcomes.text: The veteran chews, waits, and nods. It is only food. The rest eat, and nobody mentions the empty chairs.
The veteran goes grey and very still, and then laughs too long at something none of you can hear.

options.label: Push in your chairs and leave the feast to whoever it was truly laid for.

outcomes.text: You leave the chairs pushed in. Something sighs as the door closes, and the candles go out one by one behind you.
